stories.title: Define explainability display schema contract
stories.description: Define the frontend TypeScript interface for score explainability payload including overall score, measure list, weights, and contribution breakdown. Ensure compatibility with backend outputs from EVAL-EXPLAIN and structured rendering expectations in MessageBubble.

stories.title: Implement explainability rendering logic
stories.description: Build rendering logic to transform explainability payload into readable UI elements: score header, measure rows, and contribution visualization (e.g., percentages or bars) within chat messages.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx (render pipeline for markdown and structured content)

stories.title: Integrate explainability UI into MessageBubble
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble component to detect explainability payloads and render the structured score breakdown UI inline with chat responses, preserving markdown fallback for unsupported formats.

stories.title: Handle API response mapping for explainability
stories.description: Map backend responses from EVAL-SCORE-PROV, EVAL-SCORE-CT, and EVAL-EXPLAIN into the frontend explainability schema, ensuring graceful handling of missing or partial data.

stories.title: Add unit and UI tests for explainability display
stories.description: Create frontend tests validating correct rendering of score, measures, and contribution breakdown, including edge cases (empty measures, partial weights, malformed payloads).
